question: Seven inference-API offers sit in the compute topic (compute/chutes, compute/nineteen-ai, compute/ai-horde, compute/io-net-intelligence, compute/venice-ai, compute/featherless-ai, compute/hyperbolic); should they be related to the inference-topic records, and should inference/ai-horde-text and inference/hyperbolic-inference be linked as variants of compute/ai-horde and compute/hyperbolic?
why: Each has category 'inference API' but topic compute, so a query on the inference topic misses them; inference/ai-horde-text covers only the text API of compute/ai-horde, and inference/hyperbolic-inference covers the serverless inference product of the vendor behind compute/hyperbolic. relate operations need an existing rid in scope, which this unit does not have.
